lv_label.text: Smart oven demo developed in LVGL Pro, running on the RZ/A2M with Linux. Rendering is accelerated by the D/AVE 2D GPU. Runs from QSPI flash, on-chip RAM and HyperRAM, with no DDR.

• Renesas RZ/A2M EVK • MPU: 528MHz ARM Cortex-A9 (single core) • RAM: 4MB on-chip, 8MB external HyperRAM • Flash: 64MB QSPI, app runs in place (XIP) • GPU: D/AVE 2D (shapes, icons, sparks) • OS: Linux 7.3
• Resolution: 800x480 • Display Size: 7" (RSK TFT) • Interface: Parallel RGB • Color Depth: 16-bit
• Images: 6.7MB (RGB565, scaled for 800x480) • Fonts: 0.2MB • Stored in QSPI flash and read in place (XIP)
• App RAM usage (measured): ~0.2MB in HyperRAM • 2 frame buffers: 1.5MB in on-chip RAM
• Screen transitions with animations • Naturally scrolling containers • Parallax effect on meal scrolling • Background Blurring • Particle system for sparks • Various layouts for responsivity
